name: usage-guard
description: Tracks 5-hour and 7-day usage limits, warns as they climb, and blocks new subagents near the cap

warnAt.title: Warn at (% used)
warnAt.description: Show one warning when the 5-hour or 7-day window reaches this percent used

blockAt.title: Block new subagents at (% used)
blockAt.description: Refuse to start new subagents while the 5-hour or 7-day window is at or above this percent used

blockSubagents.title: Block new subagents at the cap
blockSubagents.description: Off means warnings only; nothing is ever blocked
